transformer.name: application-x-java-object
transformer.title: Application X Java Object
transformer.description: Transforms from JSon to Java object using Jackson (supports content schema)

transformerIn.description: Json read into the class of the X-Content-Class exchange property, which a body other than a POJO needs: a POJO of that class, or any POJO without it, is kept, and a Map, a List or a null body fail

transformerOut.description: An object of the class of the X-Content-Class exchange property
